title: Crop Video – Cut Edges, Make 9:16 or Square, No Upload
description: Crop a video to remove black bars or edges, or to make it square or 9:16 for Reels and TikTok. Drag the box and save; runs in your browser.
heading: Crop a Video
subtitle: Drag a box over the picture to keep only that part, free or in a fixed shape; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Cut away black bars, a messy background or the edges of a screen recording, or turn a wide video into a 9:16 clip for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Choose a shape (free, square 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 or 4:5), drag the box over the part you want and resize it from the corner. The new size in pixels is shown under the picture.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your video is cropped by your own browser and never sent to a server.

features.title: Shapes for social apps
features.text: Square, 9:16, 16:9 and 4:5 keep the box in the shape each app expects.

features.title: Mouse or keyboard
features.text: Drag the box, or move it with the arrow keys and resize with Shift.

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Pick a video or drop it on the page.

steps.title: Place the box
steps.text: Choose a shape, then drag the box over the part to keep and resize it from the corner.

steps.title: Crop and download
steps.text: Click Crop video, check the result and download it.

handles: Shapes: free, square 1:1, upright 9:16, wide 16:9 and portrait 4:5.
Sizes: the crop is made in the video's own pixels, with even widths and heights for every player.
Sound: kept when your browser can read it. If it can't, the page tells you the result has no sound.
Formats: MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV keep their format; M4V and 3GP videos become MP4.
limits: Only the first chosen video is cropped.
The box stays in one place for the whole video; it doesn't follow movement.
Cropping makes the picture smaller; to make it bigger again, use Resize video.

faq.question: Is my video uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Cropping is done by your own browser, on your device, with the video encoders built into it. Nothing is sent to a server; open your browser's network panel while it runs and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I make a video 9:16 for TikTok or Reels?
faq.answer: Choose Upright 9:16, drag the box over the part to keep and click Crop video. For an exact 1080 × 1920 size, open the result in Resize video and choose Story.

faq.question: What is the difference between crop and resize?
faq.answer: Crop cuts parts of the picture away. Resize keeps the whole picture and changes its size in pixels.

faq.question: Can I remove black bars?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose Free, move the box onto the picture inside the bars and drag its corner until it covers that picture.

faq.question: Which browsers does it work in?
faq.answer: Recent Chrome and Edge read and make the most formats; Safari and Firefox work with most videos. If your browser can't read or make a codec, the page names it and says what to try instead.

faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
